entities.summary: Manuel Baldomero Ugarte was an Argentine writer, politician, and leader of the Argentine Socialist Party. He served as an ambassador to Mexico, Nicaragua, and Cuba. He advocated for the unity of Hispanic America, and was a supporter of nationalist anti-imperialism and Hispanicism throughout the Americas and Europe.
